method_card.title: Physical Wellbeing — Body, Illness and Health
method_card.content:
This lesson covers body parts, the expression avoir mal à, illness vocabulary, and giving advice with il faut.

FrenchEnglish
la têtehead
le brasarm
la jambeleg
le ventrestomach
la gorgethroat
le dosback
le genouknee
le piedfoot
la fièvrefever
un rhumea cold
la grippeflu
maladeill
se sentirto feel
se reposerto rest
il faut + infinitiveyou must / it is necessary to

avoir mal à + contracted article: à + le = au → J'ai mal au ventre; à + la = à la → J'ai mal à la tête; à + l' = à l' → J'ai mal à l'oreille; à + les = aux → J'ai mal aux dents. Always contract à + le to au — à le does not exist in French.

il faut + infinitive = you must / it is necessary to. Give advice: Il faut se reposer = You must rest. Il ne faut pas sortir = You must not go out.

Model: Je me sens très malade. J'ai mal à la gorge et j'ai de la fièvre depuis hier. Il faut prendre des médicaments et il faut bien se reposer. — I feel very ill. I have had a sore throat and a fever since yesterday. You must take medicine and you must rest properly.
steps: Learn body parts with their genders and the correct contracted article for avoir mal à
Master key illness vocabulary (la fièvre, un rhume, la grippe)
Use il faut + infinitive to give health advice
Practice using se sentir and se reposer in context

exam_context.frequency: Common in listening/reading comprehension and the speaking role play (doctor's surgery setting)

worked_examples.question: How do you say 'I have a headache' in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Use the expression avoir mal à + the body part.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: la tête (head) is feminine and starts with a consonant → use à la.

worked_examples.question: Why does the past participle change in 'Elle s'est reposée'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Reflexive verbs use être in the passé composé — not avoir.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: With être, the past participle agrees with the subject in gender and number.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Elle is feminine → add -e to the past participle: reposée.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Because reflexive verbs use être, and the past participle must agree with the feminine subject (elle → reposée).

bronze.question: Match the French body parts to the English meaning
Match the French illness vocabulary to the English meaning
Complete the sentence with the correct contracted article

gaps.correct_explain: au is the contraction of à + le. Le ventre is masculine → au ventre.

wrong.à la: à la is for feminine nouns. Ventre is masculine — use au.
wrong.à le: à le does not exist in French — it always contracts to au.

gaps.correct_explain: à la is correct because la tête is feminine.

wrong.au: au is for masculine nouns. Tête is feminine — use à la.

gaps.correct_explain: malade = ill. Je suis malade = I am ill.
fièvre = fever. J'ai de la fièvre = I have a fever.

wrong.grippe: la grippe means flu (more serious). La fièvre = fever. Both are possible but fièvre is the better fit here.

bronze.question: What does 'J'ai mal aux dents' mean?
Which sentence correctly says 'She feels ill'?

bronze.source_text: Hier, j'ai eu mal à la gorge et j'étais très fatigué.
model_answers: Yesterday, I had a sore throat and I was very tired.
Yesterday, my throat was sore and I was very tired.
hints: j'ai eu mal à = I had a pain in / I had a sore

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: She rested because she was stressed.

gaps.rule: Past participle agreement — feminine with être
gaps.correct_explain: reposée agrees with elle (feminine). Reflexive verbs use être, so the past participle adds -e.

wrong.reposer: reposer is the infinitive. You need the past participle: reposée.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: J'ai mal à le genou depuis hier.
silver.explanation: à + le must always contract to au in French. J'ai mal au genou — à le does not exist.
silver.translation: My knee has been hurting since yesterday.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: I feel ill and I have a headache.

distractor_labels.au: wrong contraction — tête is feminine, so use à la, not au

silver.source_text: I have a sore throat and I feel tired. I should rest.
model_answers: J'ai mal à la gorge et je me sens fatigué(e). Je devrais me reposer.
hints: sore throat = avoir mal à la gorge

gold.source_text: Yesterday, I had a sore throat and I was very tired. My sister injured her arm during the match. I went to bed early to avoid tiredness.
model_answers: Hier, j'ai eu mal à la gorge et j'étais très fatigué(e). Ma sœur s'est blessée au bras pendant le match. Je me suis couché(e) tôt pour éviter la fatigue.

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: She injured her knee during the match.

distractor_labels.blessé: wrong agreement — elle is feminine, the past participle must agree: blessée (add -e)
distractor_labels.à la: wrong contraction — genou is masculine, use au not à la
distractor_labels.est: incomplete — reflexive verbs need s'est (se + est), not just est

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are visiting a doctor's surgery in France because you are feeling unwell.

bullets.prompt: Tell the doctor how you feel and describe your main symptoms.
bullets.model_answer: Je me sens très malade. J'ai mal à la gorge et j'ai de la fièvre depuis hier.
bullets.note: se sentir (reflexive) + avoir mal à la gorge + depuis + time expression

bullets.prompt: Say when the illness started and what you did (e.g. caught a cold, did not rest).
bullets.model_answer: J'ai attrapé un rhume la semaine dernière et je ne me suis pas reposé(e).
bullets.note: passé composé: attraper (avoir) + reflexive se reposer with être and negation (ne…pas)

bullets.prompt: Ask the doctor for advice on what you should do.
bullets.model_answer: Qu'est-ce que je devrais faire, docteur ? Est-ce que je dois prendre des médicaments ?
bullets.note: je devrais (conditional) + question forms; je dois + infinitive

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Je suis stressé à cause des examens. Pour me détendre, je fais du yoga et je me couche tôt pour éviter la fatigue.
gold.correct_text: Je suis stressé à cause des examens. Pour me détendre, je fais du yoga et je me couche tôt pour éviter la fatigue.
gold.translation: I am stressed because of exams. To relax, I do yoga and I go to bed early to avoid tiredness.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: Elle s'est blessé au genou pendant le match de football.
gold.explanation: Elle is feminine, and reflexive verbs use être. The past participle must agree with the subject: blessée (add -e for feminine).
gold.translation: She injured her knee during the football match.
